correctness.rationale: Independent exact enumeration for n=13,14,15 found 13/28/50 independent triples and 2757/3277/3964 bounded-independence faces including empty. A newly written ascending-mask element matcher on all nonempty faces gives 1377/1637/1980 pairs, every oriented Hasse cover topologically sorts (no gradient cycles), and exactly critical 0+5, 0+5, and 0+4+4 cells. Thus Forman gives integral wedge homotopy, not merely F2 ranks. Every subset of <=3 vertices was separately tested as an Alexander-dual face, giving full 2-skeleton and simple connectivity. Alexander duality then yields integral homology in degrees 5/6/8 with free ranks 1/1/2; Hurewicz and Whitehead imply the dual sphere wedges. Their top dimensions are 9/10/11, so lower homology forbids pure shellability.
